settings.title: Settings

v3.desc.ranked: 1v1 races on the same seed. Queue, private rooms and the Weekly Race are in the game.
v3.desc.rsg: A new random world every run. You reset in the game, as many times as you like.
v3.desc.rsg.demo: A new random world every run. You reset in the game, and we collect your times and splits.
v3.desc.fsg: Filtered seeds with a fast start. The FSG mod picks the seed in the game, and you submit with its token.
v3.desc.ssg: Pick one known seed and learn its route by heart.
v3.desc.draftout: 1v1 lockout bingo with a draft, on the newest Minecraft. Matches start in the game.
v3.strip: Your PB, split by split · gold = best segment

v3.note.fsg: The FSG Mod isn't legal on the main RSG board, so only FSG turns it on.
v3.note.ssg: Set your seed in the game. The SSG set is RSG's mods plus SetSpawn, without the RSG-only ones.

auth.title: Microsoft account
auth.why: MCSR Ranked and Draftout need a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. RSG, FSG and SSG also work offline.
auth.keystore_file_note: Saved sign-ins are protected by file permissions only (the system keyring couldn't be used when they were first saved).
auth.browser_hint: Sign in on the Microsoft page that just opened. Your password never reaches us.
auth.browser_not_opened: No browser opened. Copy this link into one:
auth.device_hint: Scan the code, or open {url} and enter:
auth.renew_warning: Couldn't renew the sign-in. It is valid until {time}.
auth.error.not_available: Ranked and Draftout need a Microsoft account, and this build has no Microsoft sign-in. RSG, FSG and SSG play offline.
auth.error.timed_out: The sign-in took too long and timed out. Start it again when you are ready.
auth.error.device_code_expired: The code expired before it was used. Start the sign-in again for a new one.
auth.error.state_mismatch: The browser returned a sign-in we didn't start. Start the sign-in again.
auth.error.app_misconfigured: Our Microsoft app registration is set up wrong. It's a bug in this build, not your account.
auth.error.relogin_required: Your Microsoft sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
auth.error.xbox_no_account: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet. Sign in once at xbox.com (or minecraft.net) to create one, then try again.
auth.error.xbox_country: Xbox Live is not available in this account's country or region, so it cannot sign in to Minecraft. A VPN doesn't help, because the block follows the account's region.
auth.error.xbox_age_verification: Microsoft needs age verification for this account (South Korea), or its playtime limit is reached. Sign in at login.live.com to verify, then try again.
auth.error.xbox_child_account: This is a child account (under 18). An adult must add it to a Microsoft family before it can play online.
auth.error.xbox_banned: This account is banned from Xbox Live, so it cannot sign in to Minecraft.
auth.error.xbox_guardian: A parent or guardian has not allowed online play for this account. They can change it at account.microsoft.com/family.
auth.error.xbox_terms: This account has not accepted the Xbox terms of use yet. Sign in once at xbox.com, accept them, then try again.
auth.error.client_not_approved: Mojang hasn't approved us for Microsoft sign-in yet, so Minecraft refused it.
auth.error.not_owned: This Microsoft account doesn't own Minecraft: Java Edition. If you play through PC Game Pass, start the game once in the official Minecraft Launcher, then try again.
auth.error.game_pass_no_profile: This account has Minecraft through PC Game Pass but no Minecraft profile yet. Start the game once in the official Minecraft Launcher (or pick a name at minecraft.net), then try again.
auth.error.no_profile: This account owns Minecraft but has no profile name yet. Pick one at minecraft.net, then try again.
auth.error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.error.network: Couldn't reach the sign-in servers. Check your internet connection.
auth.error.service: The sign-in service answered with an error. Try again later.
auth.error.keystore: Couldn't open the saved sign-ins, because the system keyring is locked or not answering. Unlock it and try again. If it's gone for good, sign out of every Microsoft account here, then sign in again.
auth.error.storage: Couldn't save or read the account list.
auth.error.unknown_account: This account isn't on the list any more.
v3.fail.sign_in: {mode} didn't start, because the Microsoft account couldn't sign in.
v3.fail.sign_in_first: Sign in with Microsoft once to play. After that you can also play without an account.
v3.retry_hint.sign_in: signs in, then starts the game

settings.player_hint_msa: Plays when no Microsoft account is active.
auth.policy: The active account plays every mode. With none active, the offline name plays.
auth.logged_in_hint: This account now plays every mode. Switch or sign out in Settings.
auth.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in…
auth.device_unavailable: The phone code isn't available right now. Use the browser.

practice.handed_over: Yours from an earlier version, which we leave alone: {worlds}
practice.req.carpet: The bastion practice uses Carpet to reset saturation and shorten the wait before a run. Without it the rest works.
practice.req.lbp-extensions: LBP Extensions by awesome-03 adds save states and more.
practice.req.render-distance-16: If the inventory doesn't load, raise the render distance; the author recommends 16.

practice.req.playerattribute: playerattribute by RedLime (in the map's release) makes the hunger and health reset work; without it that reset does nothing.
practice.req.entity-distance-175: The preemptive navigation videos use 175% entity distance.

practice.licence.open-licence: Open licence. Downloaded from the author's release.
practice.licence.permission-granted: The author allows copies. Downloaded from the author's release.

practice.credit.zero-sorting-practice-se: The optional hunger-reset mod is by RedLime.
practice.credit.llama-s-practice-map-lla: The download names its author Lama (addlama) and the map “Lama's Practice Map”.

mods.desc.antigone: Fixes a rare server deadlock in 1.16.1.
mods.desc.antiresourcereload: Skips the resource reload when a world is created.
mods.desc.atum: Resets to a new world with one key.
mods.desc.boundlesswindow: Removes the macOS title bar, so the window can be any height.
mods.desc.chunkumulator: Sends chunks to the player in batches, so worlds load faster.
mods.desc.dynamicmenufps: Lowers the frame rate in menus and in the background.
mods.desc.extra-options: Sliders that tone down FOV and distortion effects, from 1.16.2.
mods.desc.fast_reset: Skips saving the world when you reset.
mods.desc.forceport: Fixes the Open to LAN port and raises its player limit.
mods.desc.hermes: Writes the run's state for outside tools.
mods.desc.lazydfu: Starts the game faster by loading DataFixerUpper only when needed.
mods.desc.lazystronghold: Generates strongholds faster, in the background.
mods.desc.lithium: Faster game logic that plays like vanilla.
mods.desc.planifolia: The vanilla video settings screen, with Sodium.
mods.desc.retino: Renders at half resolution on Retina displays, for more frames.
mods.desc.seedqueue: Generates worlds in the background, so you reset faster.
mods.desc.setspawnmod: Sets your spawn point for set-seed runs.
mods.desc.sleepbackground: Lets instances in the background sleep, to save resources.
mods.desc.sodium: Much faster rendering and higher frame rates.
mods.desc.speedrunapi: Shared config and library code for MCSR mods.
mods.desc.speedrunigt: The in-game timer, with RTA and IGT.
mods.desc.standardsettings: Resets your settings to a set default at the start of each run.
mods.desc.starlight: A rewritten light engine, faster and with fewer lighting bugs.
mods.desc.state-output: Writes the game's state to a file for tools, without WorldPreview.
mods.desc.voyager: Fixes a rare crash on newer Java versions.
mods.desc.worldpreview: Shows the world while it generates.
mods.desc.custom-map-resetter: Resets custom maps from a saved copy and counts attempts.
mods.desc.fsg-mod: Picks a filtered seed for Atum.
mods.desc.peepopractice: Split practice with loadouts and custom categories.
mods.desc.draftout: Lockout bingo 1v1 with a draft and over 250 goals.
mods.desc.nochatrestrictions: Removes the chat and multiplayer restrictions.
mods.desc.commandqmod: Command with the drop key throws a whole stack, on macOS.
inst.shared.name: Speedrun 1.16.1
inst.shared.body: One instance for the four 1.16.1 modes: the same keys, options, resource packs and worlds. Each mode only swaps in its own mods and Atum settings, so it takes no extra space.
inst.draftout.name: Draftout
inst.draftout.body: Draftout runs the newest Minecraft, so it keeps an instance of its own.
inst.practice.name: Practice maps
inst.practice.body: The practice maps from the Practice page play here, away from your run worlds.
inst.trashed: {name} is in the trash folder of the launcher's data folder.
inst.wait_game: The game is running. Packs can change once it's closed, because the game rewrites its options when it exits.
inst.worlds.none: No worlds yet. They appear here once you play.
inst.worlds.cleanup_ask: Delete {n} ({size}) for good? Worlds you named stay.
inst.packs.added: Added {name}. Tick it to turn it on.
inst.config.none: No config files yet. Mods write them the first time the game starts.
inst.screenshots.none: No screenshots yet. F2 in the game takes one.
inst.memory_hint: 3 GB is plenty for one seed at a time. Add more for SeedQueue with many seeds queued.
inst.tools: Tools that start with the game
inst.shared.empty: Nothing is installed here yet. Download sets up Minecraft 1.16.1, Fabric and the selected mode's mods in this instance.
inst.draftout.empty: Nothing is installed here yet. Download sets up Minecraft 26.3, Fabric and Draftout's mods in this instance.
inst.practice.empty: Nothing is installed here yet. Install a map on the Practice page and play it; the practice game sets itself up here.
